title.narrative: Advocating for policy and practice reform in formal and informal economy sectors

description.narrative: Enhancing the capacity of women workers to take on leadership roles and strengthening social movement to actively engage in collective action to promote the right to decent work for all. Capacitating the women workers to monitor the implementation of policies and to collectively document case study and evidence for advocacy purposes. Promoting policy and social dialogue between women workers and their representatives and public and private actors in order ensure that corporations and the government are held accountable and to advance decent work and inclusive social protection. .

The goal of the project is to promote meaningful engagement and leadership of women workers in social dialogueUsing human rights based approach and top ten feminist leadership, AAC empowers women-led alliances and associations, formal and informal sector unions representing women workers, human rights defenders, social movements and networks to seize opportunities that advance and strengthen leadership and participation of women in social dialogue and societal change at all levels.In collaboration with partners - women led unions - AAC will plan and carry out the participatory research initiative with the active participation of women workers in the target areas/factories. Through offline and online venues, trade union women leaders and active workers will organise public awareness campaigns on the employment and conditions of women workers using innovative and workers friendly initiatives.
